instruction: In 42_2.pptx, set the picture height to 18cm on slide 3 and change all textbox font sizes to 36pt on slide 6.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies 'Group 6' shape on slide 3 by name, matching what the trajectory confirms ('Group object Group 6 selected'), and converts EMU to cm correctly (/ 360000).
Metric correctly handles expected parameter as rules dict (direct access via expected.get(...)) since expected.type='rule', with appropriate 0.1cm tolerance for height.
Both sub-goals (slide3 height and slide6 fonts) are covered with symmetric 0.5+0.5 partial credit, matching the two-requirement instruction.

Task metadata confirms getter successfully detected initial font sizes (32/23/80pt) via shape_type==1 filter, validating that the textboxes in 42_2.pptx are stored as AUTO_SHAPE (type 1) rather than TEXT_BOX (type 17).
Postconfig (Ctrl+S) ensures the file is saved before getter reads it from disk, preventing stale-state issues.

Minor risk: getter only checks run-level font sizes (run.font.size), not paragraph-level or inherited theme fonts. Textboxes with no explicit run-level size are silently excluded from slide6_font_sizes, creating a potential false-positive gap if some textboxes set font only at paragraph level.
Minor risk: if slide6_font_sizes ends up empty (no shapes with explicit run-level fonts), the font check defaults to 0.0 rather than flagging an error, which could cause false negatives.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: In the getter's slide 6 loop, also collect paragraph-level font sizes (para.runs being empty but para.font.size set) so textboxes with only paragraph-level formatting are not silently ignored.
Consider also checking shape_type == 17 (MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.TEXT_BOX) in addition to shape_type == 1 to ensure real text box shapes are captured if the file format varies.
In the metric, if slide6_fonts is empty but slide 6 has visible text shapes, treat it as a verification failure (return 0.0 with a warning) rather than silently returning 0.0.
